import inspect
import click

@click.group()
def cli():
    pass

@cli.command(help="Visible help")
def visible():
    pass

@cli.command(hidden=True, help="Hidden help")
def secret():
    pass

ctx = click.Context(cli)
for kwargs, expected in (({}, False), ({"include_hidden": False}, False), ({"include_hidden": True}, True)):
    formatter = click.HelpFormatter()
    cli.format_commands(ctx, formatter, **kwargs)
    output = formatter.getvalue()
    assert "Commands:" in output
    assert "visible" in output and "Visible help" in output
    assert ("secret" in output) is expected
    assert ("Hidden help" in output) is expected
parameter = inspect.signature(click.MultiCommand.format_commands).parameters["include_hidden"]
assert parameter.kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
assert parameter.default is False
print("Focused formatting checks passed")
